name: From a quiz. The choices given for the next two terms are: i) 12,32; ii) 22,18; iii) 17,64; iv) 5,21; v) 13,19.
comment: Possibly 17, 64 should be the next terms. Every square in the sequence is the square of sum of first k digits of concatenations of previous two terms except the last digit. For example: concatenation of 16 and 17 is 1617 and (1 + 6 + 1)^2 = 64. - _Metin Sariyar_, May 03 2020
author: Madhav Narayanan (madhav.narayanan(AT)iiitb.ac.in), Apr 15 2004
